name: Demo Speakers
description: One row per conference speaker. Synthetic demo data.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Name
fields.description: Speaker full name.

fields.name: email
fields.label: Email
fields.description: Lowercase email. Used to check for duplicates.

fields.name: session
fields.label: Session
fields.description: Session title or type.

fields.name: status
fields.label: Status
fields.description: One of: invited, confirmed, declined.

fields.name: bio_received
fields.label: Bio received
fields.description: Yes once the bio has arrived.

fields.name: headshot_received
fields.label: Headshot received
fields.description: Yes once the headshot has arrived.

fields.name: travel_notes
fields.label: Travel notes
fields.description: What travel is needed and what is booked.

fields.name: checked_by_person
fields.label: Checked by person
fields.description: Yes when a person has reviewed this row in the app. Agents must not overwrite values on a checked row without asking.

name: Demo Sponsors
description: One row per sponsor or sponsor prospect. Synthetic demo data.

fields.name: company
fields.label: Company
fields.description: Company name.

fields.name: domain
fields.label: Domain
fields.description: Bare website domain, lowercase. Used to check for duplicates.

fields.name: level
fields.label: Level
fields.description: One of: gold, silver, bronze.

fields.name: amount
fields.label: Amount
fields.description: Sponsorship amount in USD, no symbols.

fields.name: contract_status
fields.label: Contract status
fields.description: One of: prospect, verbal_yes, signed.

fields.name: payment_status
fields.label: Payment status
fields.description: One of: not_invoiced, invoiced, paid.

fields.name: checked_by_person
fields.label: Checked by person
fields.description: Yes when a person has reviewed this row in the app. Agents must not overwrite values on a checked row without asking.

name: Demo Open Items
description: One row per promise or to-do owed to a speaker or sponsor. Synthetic demo data. This list answers "what is outstanding this week".

fields.name: item
fields.label: Item
fields.description: What has to be done, written so anyone on the team could do it.

fields.name: speaker
fields.label: Speaker
fields.description: The speaker this is for, if any.

fields.name: sponsor
fields.label: Sponsor
fields.description: The sponsor this is for, if any.

fields.name: owner
fields.label: Owner
fields.description: Team member responsible: maya, jordan, or sam. Leave empty if nobody has taken it.

fields.name: due
fields.label: Due
fields.description: Date it is due, YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.name: done
fields.label: Done
fields.description: Yes when finished. Always set explicitly; new items start as no.

fields.name: source
fields.label: Source
fields.description: Where this came from, for example the email subject and date.

fields.name: recorded_by
fields.label: Recorded by
fields.description: Which assistant recorded it.

fields.name: checked_by_person
fields.label: Checked by person
fields.description: Yes when a person has reviewed this row in the app. Agents must not overwrite values on a checked row without asking.
